rows_or_batches.reason: paired-SQL DDL effect; row/batch processing is outside the migration file

lock_wait.signal_or_method: PostgreSQL lock wait duration for the migration statement

replication_lag.signal_or_method: replication lag before, during, and after the migration

wal_growth.signal_or_method: WAL growth during the migration window

disk_growth.signal_or_method: relation and index disk growth during the migration window

validation_mismatches.reason: schema Expand step; Stage 3.71 owner population command performs ledger validation

retry_pause_abort_reason.signal_or_method: deployment log records retry, pause, or abort reason

change_deployment_correlation.signal_or_method: deployment record correlates migration id, application revision, and rollout window

monitoring.success_condition: DDL completes within declared timeout with no sustained lock wait, replication lag, or unexpected disk/WAL growth.
monitoring.abort_condition: Abort on timeout, sustained lock wait, replication lag growth, unexpected disk/WAL growth, or any deployment correlation mismatch.

production_rollback.procedure: Stop Stage 3.71 activation and leave the additive structure unused; use paired DOWN only before accepted Stage 3.71 financial writes exist.
production_rollback.verification: Stage 3.71 runtime remains disabled and pre-existing transaction semantics remain unchanged.

roll_forward.procedure: Complete Expand migrations, deterministic owner-only ledger sequence population, structural verification, then activate the Stage 3.71 runtime.
roll_forward.verification: Runtime readiness reports the unique index present and zero NULL/non-positive/duplicate portfolio-local ledger sequences.

up_ddl_impact.abort_condition: Abort if lock acquisition exceeds 5000ms or statement duration exceeds 30000ms.
up_ddl_impact.estimate_basis: Nullable BIGINT column without DEFAULT is a catalog/tuple-descriptor Expand step and is not expected to rewrite existing heap rows.

down_ddl_impact.abort_condition: Abort if lock acquisition exceeds 5000ms or statement duration exceeds 30000ms.
down_ddl_impact.estimate_basis: DOWN removes only the additive ledger_sequence column before runtime activation; no financial fact column is touched.

monitoring.success_condition: DDL completes within declared timeout with no sustained lock wait, replication lag, or unexpected disk/WAL growth.
monitoring.abort_condition: Abort on timeout, sustained lock wait, replication lag growth, unexpected disk/WAL growth, or any deployment correlation mismatch.

production_rollback.procedure: Stop Stage 3.71 activation and leave the additive structure unused; use paired DOWN only before accepted Stage 3.71 financial writes exist.
production_rollback.verification: Stage 3.71 runtime remains disabled and pre-existing transaction semantics remain unchanged.

roll_forward.procedure: Complete Expand migrations, deterministic owner-only ledger sequence population, structural verification, then activate the Stage 3.71 runtime.
roll_forward.verification: Runtime readiness reports the unique index present and zero NULL/non-positive/duplicate portfolio-local ledger sequences.

up_ddl_impact.abort_condition: Abort on timeout, sustained replication lag, or index build failure; do not activate Stage 3.71 runtime.
up_ddl_impact.estimate_basis: Conservative zero-budget MVP deployment envelope for pre-activation ledger rows; actual relation size is checked during rollout.

down_ddl_impact.abort_condition: Abort on timeout or concurrent drop failure; keep Stage 3.71 runtime disabled.
down_ddl_impact.estimate_basis: Inverse of the Stage 3.71 portfolio-local ledger sequence unique index build.
